text:
Emma: Quick ask — can we rebalance co-marketing credits across Tier A/B partners this quarter? Partner X shifted launch date and needs an immediate top-up.

Rajesh: What's the delta we are talking about? can we cover from the contingency bucket or does this need a board-level approve? :thinking_face:

Emma: Short version: $60k total, we can pull $40k from the marketplace pilot underspend and $20k from the general MDF contingency. Spreadsheet linked: https://go.redwood.internal/sheets/partner-credits-2026

Oliver: If we move $40k from marketplace pilot we drop runway for two planned pilots (APAC HW credits + SI onboarding). Do we have a deprioritization list?

Maya: We should tie this to scorecard outputs — Partner X has met 95% of enablement KPIs but is behind ARR attainment. For QBR narrative, reallocate + document a 30-day impact check and fallbacks.

Emma: Agreed. Proposed steps: 1) Move funds (temp) 2) Update partner scorecard to show credit usage 3) Review at QBR + 30-day check 4) If ARR < target, revert. Anyone opposed?

Rajesh: No strong objections. Need finance sign-off. tagging @maya for the scorecard update and @oliver for pilot deprioritization list.

Maya: I'll update the scorecard today and add a comment explaining the justification. Will include the exact fields we show in the QBR: "enablement %", "pipeline influenced", "credit utilization".

Oliver: I'll list the two pilots and impact if credits pulled. Also adding a note about APAC latency credits — we might be able to source partial from region-specific marketing funds.

salesbot: Reminder — Quarterly Business Review scheduled Thu 2026-04-02 10:00 UTC. Agenda slot for partner credit decisions reserved.

Emma: Thx. Action items: Maya updates scorecard (due EOD), Oliver provides deprior list (EOD), Emma to submit finance request (tomorrow AM). If finance approves, I'll process the temp transfer and log in partner ledger.

Rajesh: One more ask — can we add an explicit metric to scorecards that flags temporary credit transfers so the QBR panel sees them? simple boolean field "credit_transfer_flag" should do it.

Maya: Good call. I'll add the field and backfill for last 6 months where we did ad-hoc moves.

Emma: Perfect. I'll PR an internal blurb for the QBR slide deck (2 bullets) once finance confirms. :thumbsup:

Oliver: If anyone wants to run alternate scenarios (e.g., partial transfer + co-bill model) I can run numbers quickly — ping me.

Maya: Done — scorecard updated and added the credit_transfer_flag quirk with notes. Link: https://go.redwood.internal/sheets/partner-scorecards-2026#gid=43

Emma: Filed the finance request (REQ-2026-118). Keeping thread here for audit trail. Will post outcome.

salesbot: Finance request REQ-2026-118 created by emma. Status: awaiting-approval.

Rajesh: Thanks all. If finance approves, we'll call this the "co-marketing rebalancing" item on the QBR so execs can see rationale and the 30-day check plan.

Emma: Closing loop — finance approved (email chain copied into finance-docs). Temp transfer scheduled for 2026-03-30. Will confirm post-transfer.
